purpose: 將既有法師、戰士改為約 3 頭身，保留人物造型與透明背景

prompts.wizard:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image: EDIT TARGET, preserve this character and its handmade illustration style.
Primary request: redraw the SAME character as a TRUE THREE-HEAD-TALL Japanese tabletop-game chibi. The current body and legs are too long. This edit must visibly change the silhouette and proportions, not just resize the canvas.
Keep this exact wizard identity: ash-brown tousled hair, amber eyes, slight smile, indigo-violet robe and hood resting behind head, antique brass fastenings, worn boots, thick open spellbook in one arm and tiny gold wisp above the other raised hand.
Proportion specification, highest priority: the full standing figure from the TOP OF THE SKULL to the SOLE OF THE LOWEST BOOT must measure THREE times the skull-top-to-chin head height, with acceptable ratio 2.9–3.1. Ignore the small loose hair tuft when measuring. One unit for the large round head, ONE unit from chin to hips, ONE unit from hips to boot soles. Shorten BOTH torso and legs substantially and enlarge the head relative to the body. Big roundish head, compact chest and waist, short thighs and shins, small sturdy boots. The head should occupy about one third of the total figure height. Do NOT produce 3.5, 4 or 5 head proportions.
Keep invariants: same face design and expression, same hairstyle and colors, same outfit and accessories, same calm three-quarter pose, warm brown hand-inked contours, fine colored pencil / muted watercolor textures. Simplify tiny clothing details only as needed for the shorter compact body. Keep hands anatomically readable; downsize the props to fit the compact figure.
Composition: square image, one entire full-body character centered with a small margin around hair and soles, no cropped parts, no extra character or inset. Genuine fully transparent background, preserve clean alpha edges.
No text, no labels, no measurement marks, no ruler, no proportion diagram, no card border, no scene, no floor, no glow behind the whole figure, no 3D or glossy rendering.
